learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to level up our travel math by understanding awesome maps, secret scales, and planning multi-city adventures!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Maps are amazing flat drawings of our big round world. They help us clearly see where different cities, rivers, and high mountains are located.
We cannot draw a real 100-kilometer long road on paper! So we use a smart scale where 1 centimeter on the map might equal 10 kilometers in real life.
To travel smartly without getting lost, we need to know our main directions: North, South, East, and West. A compass is a tool that helps us find our way!

fun_activity.title: 🗺️ My Bedroom Map Masterpiece
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a top-view map of your bedroom on paper. Try using a fun scale where 1 hand-span in real life equals 1 finger-width on your drawing!

quick_recap: ⭐ Maps help us clearly see huge places on a small piece of paper.
⭐ A map scale tells us how much short distance on the map equals the long real distance.
⭐ Knowing North, South, East, and West keeps us safe and on the right route!
